title: Nvidia Without Jensen Huang: What's Next for the AI King?
author: KumoPaper
selftext:
[Nvidia tanked nearly 8% in after-hours trading as rumors broke the board is prepping to oust Jensen Huang. ](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1004345858?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D)The board could vote as soon as Nov 11 with no official word locked in yet.

Past successions prove big tech can survive its founders—Apple thrived after Steve Jobs stepped back, Uber turned profitable post Travis Kalanick. But Huang’s fingerprints are all over Nvidia’s tech roadmap, client relationships and daily operations, making this way trickier.

Possible interim leader is CFO Colette Kress, while long-term candidates include CUDA pioneer Ian Buck and ex-Nvidia exec Rene Haas. Even AMD’s Lisa Su is floating as an outside shot, though that’s a long shot given their direct rivalry.

AMD, Broadcom and Marvell might see a boost if cloud players rush to diversify their AI chip suppliers, but Nvidia’s CUDA ecosystem is still a massive barrier to switch around. With earnings landing Nov 17, the next few days will be a huge test of Wall Street’s confidence in the AI trade. Would you still hold Nvidia if Huang exits?

comments.author: Stunning_Room7648
comments.body: Apple and Uber both got through it, and Nvidia's foundation is stronger.
